field_serverUrlHint: The address the server’s pages sit under, such as https://cas.example.edu/cas
field_identityPrincipal: The name they sign in with
field_attributeNameHint: Exactly as the server spells it, such as id_number
field_fallback: Use the sign-in name when the attribute is missing
field_customHint: Leave empty to use the CAS 3.0 address under the server address
field_renew: Ask for the password every time
error_ticketRejected: Single sign-on did not confirm who you are. Try again.
error_upstreamUnavailable: Single sign-on cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
error_responseInvalid: Single sign-on answered in a way Qualy cannot read. Contact an administrator.
